summary: CRT float display-format wrapper in the Trandisp1 module. Loads the double argument a1 into the x87 float stack through CRTFload, calls Trandisp1 passing the loaded value together with register-sourced arguments (v2/edx, v3/cx, v4/fps) and the address of the saved-register frame, then calls sub_590703 on that same frame and returns its result. No callers are recorded, so the display context is unknown.

local_names.savedregs: saved-register frame whose address is threaded through Trandisp1 and sub_590703
local_names.v2: uninitialized edx-derived argument passed to Trandisp1
local_names.v3: uninitialized cx-derived argument passed to Trandisp1
local_names.v4: uninitialized fps-derived argument passed to Trandisp1

operations.description: Load the double argument a1 through CRTFload into the x87 float value v1 (st7).
Call Trandisp1 with the register-sourced arguments v2 (edx), v3 (cx), v4 (fps), the address of the saved-register frame savedregs and the loaded float v1.
Call sub_590703 with the saved-register frame address savedregs to derive the final result.
Return the result of sub_590703 directly; the function has no other side effect.
